operation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9)
operation.why: Best stated accuracy (1 m) whose area covers the GB points; applied to in-area points only.

assumptions: Input is OSGB36 geographic (EPSG:4277) latitude/longitude as given.
notes: P05 (47.16N, 2.05E, central France) and P06 (56.28N, 120.99E, eastern Siberia) lie outside the area of use of OSGB36 and of EPSG:7710, so they were not transformed. Likely mis-keyed or wrong-datum rows; left as null for the person to check.
